title: spermacoce patula
intro: Spermacoce patula, commonly known as the "Dog Fennel", is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family, known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Spermacoce patula include its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal activities, which can aid in the treatment of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as a treatment for fever, rheumatism, and as a digestive aid. The bioactive constituents of Spermacoce patula include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
